reviews.text: I'm so happy with Mayra! Thanks to her and her manager, my dog ​​will be able to eat these days while the bag of food arrives. They're so sweet!! 🫶🩷 …

It's wonderful to hear that your experience was positive and that you rated it 4 stars, Yan. We strive to always offer the best for you and your pets. We hope to see you again soon at Kiwoko, where the animal world is our passion.
Adorable shop with everything a little bird needs, thank you so much for your recommendations!!

Lucía, your 5-star rating reflects our commitment to our customers and their pets. It's a pleasure to know that your experience with Kiwoko has been so positive. We hope to continue being your trusted store for all your pet care needs.
I like this place; there are many things and they are of good quality.

It's a real pleasure to receive such a positive review from you, Monica. We're delighted to know that your experience at Kiwoko was worthy of five stars. We are committed to animal welfare, and comments like yours inspire us to continue with our mission.
The staff's service is the best... They answer every question you have 🤩 …
A great place to buy pet supplies. They have a wide variety and the staff helped me choose the food I was looking for.
The Alcalá store is one of the small ones and if your pet is neither a dog nor a cat you have few shopping options.
Great prices and deals. Attentive staff. Highly recommended.
Thanks 💕 …
Great pet shop where you can find everything you need for your loyal friend 🐕🐈‍⬛🐢🦎🐦‍⬛🦜🐭..... …
Iván and Manuel were lovely and gave us fantastic service. It was truly a delight to visit this shop, and I'll definitely be back! Thank you so much for your attention.
A great selection of products for our pets. Excellent customer service.

Terrible service.
A product that was listed as in stock on the Kiwoko website was unavailable, and they refused to check which branch had it in stock. They made no effort whatsoever, neither checking their internal website nor calling their colleagues. The two people who helped me seemed genuinely unwilling to assist. It was as if I were bothering them, when I was simply making a reasonable inquiry. I recommend calling ahead and trying to avoid that branch.

I want to thank the amazing Kiwoko team for making every visit an excellent experience.

Especially Karla, Mariana, Maira, and Howar, who always greet me with a smile, a friendly attitude, and a genuine willingness to help.

Their customer service is exceptional: they take the time to answer questions, offer knowledgeable recommendations, and ensure that Ginger and Luca always receive the best care.

Their professionalism, friendliness, and dedication make every visit a pleasant one, leaving you with the peace of mind of having received the best possible advice.

It's a true pleasure to find such professional, friendly, and committed people.

Without a doubt, they are one of the reasons I continue to choose Kiwoko. Thank you so much for your excellent work and for making a difference with every visit!

It's a true privilege to receive such a positive review as yours, Sofia. We greatly appreciate your support and the time you've taken to share your experience. Thank you for being part of our community and for trusting our services.
Everything you need for the pet world
The telephone service was excellent. I asked the guys twice to help me by sending some fresh hay and they helped me with my request.
Ivan gave me excellent service; they didn't have what I asked for and he called other stores to find it for me, wonderful service.
An amazing store! Ivan's service is excellent: the attention, the friendly way he makes you feel... wonderful

Often they don't have what you're looking for, and the store staff is slow when there are people waiting to pay; they only open one register and the others don't help. It's a bit frustrating, especially when you're in a hurry.

Very pleasant staff, great customer service, and they had exactly the mealworms I was looking for, much larger than the ones I'd been offered at another store. The price was a bit inflated, but understandable.

Maite, we're so glad to receive your feedback! Your support means so much to us and motivates us to continue providing the best for you and your pets. We hope to see you in our store soon; you're always welcome. Thank you for choosing Kiwoko!

Ernesto, it's a real pleasure to receive such a positive review. Thank you for trusting Kiwoko and sharing your experience with the community. We hope you continue to enjoy our products and services for the well-being of your animals.
We love Kiwoko! We got everything my little dog needs there. She loves it too! 🐶 …

D Martin, what a joy to see such a positive review! It's wonderful to know that your experience at Kiwoko was worthy of a perfect review. Thank you for trusting us with the care of your furry friends.
It's always a pleasure to come here, the staff couldn't be better!

COMPLETELY DISAPPOINTING. I bought a cooling mat for my pet, and after only two months of normal use, it stopped working after being stored in the closet.
When I went to the store to request a solution, they told me that, since I didn't have the receipt, they couldn't process any warranty claim.
Obviously, nobody keeps the receipt after a month.
As a consumer, I believe they should offer more options for proving the purchase, especially since many purchases are recorded if made by card or through a customer account. I felt neglected and that my consumer rights were disregarded.
I expected better after-sales service and a solution in accordance with warranty regulations. In my case, the experience was negative, and I wouldn't recommend them.
Ana provided great attention and advice!
Excellent customer service!!
Your feedback makes our day, Andreea. We're so glad you had such a positive experience at Kiwoko. We hope to continue earning your trust and support in the future.

Always great service and recommendations. It's my go-to store for buying food for my furry friends. They have a wide variety of products, and if it's not in stock, you can order it online and it will arrive quickly. 🩷🐾 …
It's wonderful to receive your feedback, Beatriz. We're delighted to hear that your experience with us has been so positive. We hope to see you soon at Kiwoko, Mundo Animal.

A pleasure, as always, but this time Ivan was very attentive and kind. I like his attitude, and it's clear he loves his job.
I wish there were more people like him who felt as much love for animals as he does. 🥰 …
Everything was great and they organize charity events, Ivan was very helpful!
Great experience and service

Top-notch service. ✨️

Always friendly and willing to help.
It's a pleasure to receive your feedback, Carmen. Knowing you had a positive experience at Kiwoko means a lot to us. Whenever you need us, we'll be here for you and your pets.

They close at 10 PM, but at 9:42 PM they're turning off all the lights in the store and starting to mop with bleach. Excuse me? What are the actual hours? I visited today, June 25th, at 9:38 PM. How is it possible that I'm in the cat food section and they've already turned off the lights?
It's so nice to read your review, Carmen. We're thrilled to know your experience with Kiwoko has been so positive. We hope to continue being your top choice for all your pet care needs.
It's always a pleasure to come and buy things for Pepa. Great service and very friendly. 🙂🙂 …

Thank you so much for your feedback, Eva. It's wonderful to know your experience was positive and continues to motivate us. If there's anything we can do in the future to help us achieve a fifth star, we'd be delighted to try.
This place is great, it has a huge variety and its staff, especially Mariana, is very friendly.
Excellent service!

It's an honor to receive such a positive review, Covadonga. We're delighted to know that your experience at Kiwoko was satisfactory. We will continue working diligently to offer you the best on every visit.
Excellent service and good products
The staff who serve you are very friendly.
It was great! I went to get some things for my puppy and they treated me wonderfully! They gave me exactly what I needed.
I love Kiwoko; I've been buying their food since I got my dog. They have the perfect food for her, their customer service is great, and they give excellent advice about dogs. ☺️

Excellent service. I went because I found a chick that had fallen from its nest and needed guidance on how to feed it. They were incredibly kind and helpful. I highly recommend the staff at this store.

It's a real pleasure to see reviews like yours. Happy, your 5 stars inspire us to continue being a great partner for you and your pets. Thank you for sharing your positive experience with us and for being part of our animal-loving community.

My go-to Kiwoko. The staff are very attentive and they have a great selection of products :)
Florence, your positive feedback encourages us every day. We truly appreciate you taking the time to share your experience. It will always be a pleasure to welcome you back to Kiwoko.

Ivan and Mayra's service is fantastic!

Raul and Mayra gave us fantastic service!

Thank you so much!
Great store, excellent customer service
Otto's favorite place! The service is amazing and they always have everything we need! Today Iván served us and he truly provided the best service!
Excellent service and friendliness!

I recommend Mayra, the sales assistant at the Kiwoco store on Calle Alcalá 157. She was very helpful in finding what you're looking for and very kind. I will definitely buy my next pet supplies there.
Very good store and excellent service.
I like the shop, it's always tidy and clean. Mayra's service is very personalized, and her advice has been great for finding the right harnesses for my furry friend. THANK YOU!

Terrible customer service. I went in asking for a specific food for my cat, a high-end brand, and at the same time I was holding another bag of lower-quality food. The guy who helped me said they didn't have what I was looking for but that another brand of similar quality had a similar product. On the way to the aisle, he said to me in a very rude tone: "I'm telling you, if you're going to buy him something from these better brands but then take that crap, what's the point?" When I proceeded to explain why (which I didn't have to, honestly, it's my decision), he said, "Well, he is picky." I understand the point of the message and the inconsistency of my purchases, but the way he was treated was unacceptable. Everyone does what they do for their own reasons, and the comment was completely out of line and had no context (my financial situation, whether it was for me, whether it was for homeless cats, whether my cat was going to die). In all honesty, I bought it because I needed to feed my cat and it was Sunday; otherwise, I would have left the purchase. Completely unacceptable treatment, I will not return.
I love the store, it's always very tidy, clean, and has the necessary items for our little ones. Ivan and Mayra are very helpful, and I love the offers available.
